body.x: SOLO participated in ‘CES 2018(Consumer Technology Show)’, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics show held in Las Vegas, the U.S.A. from Tues. 9th to Fri. 12th in Jan. and introduced a useful electric vehicle for commute.

This car has no exhaust emissions and is a product that can satisfy customers with its sophisticated design. It has three colors, black, white, and red, and it can be fully charged for 3 hours on 220V. It is expected that the number of customer range who wants to own the SOLO that can be used suitably for commute without environmental pollution will be expanding.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
